diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~86% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series crosses zero, so percentage errors are unstable and mean-based combinations are safer than ratio-based ones. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.329), which favours a weighted combination.
